answer_result.answer: The evidence documents one mishap for Calvin: a car accident on 2023-06-16, which he described as a "lil car accident" and "kinda upsetting," though no one was hurt. He then dealt with insurance and repairs; the insurance process was a hassle with lots of paperwork but was sorted out within a week, and as of 2023-06-21 the car was at an auto repair shop. By 2023-07-07, he said the car was fixed and going strong.

- On 2023-06-21, told Dave he had "a lil car accident" last Friday (2023-06-16) — "kinda upsetting" but no one was hurt; shared a photo of a red car with a black rim parked on a sidewalk (his red sports car, see ## New luxury car (Ferrari, 2023-03-26)) [S9T1].

- As of 2023-06-21 the car is at an auto repair shop being fixed up — "can't wait to drive it again"; shared a photo of a tow truck parked in a parking lot [S9T3].

Details of the accident and repair are in /memories/calvin.md > ## Car accident (2023-06-16) [S9T2][S9T4][S9T6][S9T8].
- On 2023-06-21 (continuing the car-repair conversation), Dave said it's awesome that Calvin trusts the people fixing the car — "Sounds like they're doing a great job. It'll be back to normal soon!" [S9T10].
- On 2023-06-21, Calvin then shared a photo of a small-town view in Japan with a mountain in the background; Dave marveled at it — "I haven't seen anything like that before!" — asked where it was and whether Calvin has been there; Calvin said not yet, but it's on his to-do list for after the Frank Ocean tour — see /memories/calvin.md > ## Japan plan [S9T11][S9T12][S9T13][S9T14][S9T15].

[S7T17][S7T18][S7T19].
- On 2023-06-09, caught up with Dave: told him about the creative-team album session (details in ## Music) and that he's "stoked" about the album; Dave shared a photo of a pond with a boat in it surrounded by trees, and Calvin shared a photo of the studio (details in ## Music) and one of a tree with pink flowers (details in ## Boston trip) [S8T1][S8T2][S8T3][S8T5]. They talked about nature: Dave has been exploring parks on weekends to relax; Calvin, having never been to Boston, is "can't wait" to visit in July 2023 and asked about the Boston parks (details in ## Boston trip); when Calvin asked if Dave has been on any hikes recently, Dave said no but thinks hiking is awesome — "being in nature and pushing yourself to new heights"; details on Dave's park habit and his Boston-parks stroll are in /memories/dave.md > ## Parks [S8T4][S8T5][S8T6][S8T7][S8T8]. Dave then announced that he recently joined a rock band and has been practicing guitar, sharing a photo of the band; Calvin said it's awesome and will bring him a lot of emotions, and Dave said good company and great music lift the mood and bring positive emotions (details in the Rock band section of /memories/dave.md).
